"""Returns a 2D texture represented as a list of 4 channels (RGBA), each a 2D array of size h x w."""
return [[[0] * w for _ in range(h)] for _ in range(4)]
"""Copies slice_data (h x w array) into texture[channel_idx] at offset (x, y)."""
